subject: P-7F3K9Q.T2
goal_echo: G-03: users can organize notes with tags; this task stores each tag once, normalized.
summary: Added normalizeTag and TagStore.addTag in src/store/tags.ts, exported TagStore from src/store/index.ts, and made NoteStore.load default a missing tags array to an empty list. Both frozen tag tests pass locally.

rulings.what: Lowercase with String.prototype.toLowerCase after NFC normalization, not toLocaleLowerCase.
rulings.why: A locale-dependent lowercase would store different tags on machines with different locales, for example the Turkish dotted I.

handoff.notes: normalizeTag is internal to src/store/; core calls TagStore.addTag only.
not_tested: Concurrent addTag calls on the same note (the store is single-writer).
